assurance: Source-only evaluation, not verified Jenkins/GitHub Actions runtime equivalence. The reviewer and behavior mapping are LLM judgments, not deterministic proof.

checks.name: workflow_structure
checks.detail: Basic job/step structure and dependencies checked.

limitations: This is a source-only assessment; workflow execution, action compatibility in the container, and Gradle command outcomes were not verified.
Without the Gradle project configuration, it is not possible to establish whether test or check tasks modify JAR outputs after the build workspace is transferred.

The declared differences remain: isolated job workspaces do not reproduce Jenkins parallel shared-workspace interactions, Actions reporting and timestamps differ, and artifact uploads do not provide Jenkins fingerprinting.
